sentences.text:
Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.
Hon'ble Vivek Kumar Birla,J.
Hon'ble Surendra Singh-I,J.
Heard Sri Ashok Kumar Singh, learned counsel for the petitioner and Ms. Manju Thakur, learned A.G.A. for the State respondents.

In pith and substance, the petitioner is seeking direction to respondents to ensure fair, impartial and proper investigation of the Case Crime No. 60 of 2022, under sections 498A, 302 IPC, P.S. Sarai Mamrej, District Prayagraj with the further prayer not to arrest the petitioner pursuant to said FIR.

At the very outset, learned AGA has informed the Court that Section 302 IPC has been deleted and Section 366 has been added during the course of investigation and further proceeding is going on in the present case.

Dilip Yadav vs State Of U.P.And 6 Others on 20 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/105475719/

sentences.text: However, learned counsel for the petitioner submits that more than one year has passed but investigation is not completed till date.
Learned counsel has prayed for issuance of suitable direction for fair and impartial investigation.
Learned A.G.A. submits that the police authorities are under the obligation to do the investigation fairly, impartially and expeditiously and the same would be done in accordance with law.

The present petition is disposed of directing the police authorities to conclude the investigation of the said case fairly, impartially and expeditiously, preferably within three months from the date of production of a certified copy of this order before them.
It is made clear that this Court has not expressed any opinion on the merits of the case and the competent authority to act in accordance with law.
